gn-04-door.note: Seven nodes, three episodes. Needs a cave OR high stage (either tag). Raid marks read team-raid-moon-won / team-raid-moon-lost.

gn-05-barn.level: friends A-2, Damian A+0, ace A+1

beats.beat: Meeting 3: an inspected Gym (the region after)

gn-05-barn.note: At most once per region; walking past costs nothing; never the stage's Gym.

gn-03-door.note: Six nodes. The duel is at equal levels.

gn-42-door.level: By rank: Brains bring 3 Pokémon at A+0 (Bronze), 4 at A+1 (Silver), 5 at A+1 with held items (Gold), 6 at A+2 (Platinum)
gn-42-door.note: Badge: a crossed-swords crest. Once per region, from the second region. SF114 (ps-battle-frontier-gate) is its front gate, with the same clerk. The rank and the Brains' memory last the run (no memory across runs).

gn-43-door.note: Badge: a gavel. Once per region. SF125's pop-up and silent auction are small versions of this; the black-market auction is gn.52. Until towns exist it sits on step 15.

gn-44-door.level: All scaled to the Pokémon the player enters (same level; the champion one higher)
gn-44-door.note: Badge: a single star. Once per region. Gideon Tolland and Señora Dolores Vantongeren are always rounds 3 and 6, and remember the last entrant within the run (no memory across runs). Until towns exist it sits on step 15.

gn-46-door.note: Badge: three stars. Once per run, late; needs seven named trainers met this run. Until towns exist it sits on step 16. Entrants are drawn from the trainers fought this run (core/greenneedle/allstar.ts); the strongest rival is always in the final.

gn-47-door.level: If invited: A+2, with no loss cost
gn-47-door.note: Badge: a ticket. Once per region; each matchup once per run. Until towns exist it sits on step 15. The match is told in three parts (core/greenneedle/exhibition.ts); a move watched closely is free once at any move tutor; a trainer in a later stage copies a move from it.

gn-48-door.note: Badge: a clipboard. Once per region. Until towns exist it sits on step 14. Six picks from cards (core/greenneedle/draft.ts), five battles, a bracket of three; one drafted Pokémon may stay. Its trainer writes once a region (gn-48-letter).

gn-48-letter.note: Once a region, while a drafted Pokémon that stayed is with you: its first trainer writes. "Write back." gives it Bond +1.

gn-49-hill.note: Badge: a large "Zzz". Lies across a single-node column, so there is no way round on the map. In Kanto the canon space cs-kanto-route-snorlax shows it instead.

gn-49-later.note: Afterstory: a Snorlax that did not join, asleep across the road in a later region. Fought, it needs "Ask nicely."

gn-50-offer.level: The theft: A+1. The defector as a boss: A+2
gn-50-offer.note: Badge: none for the offer, a folded note after. Only in a region with an evil-team story. Corin Bellweather is rank and file, not the lieutenant. The three "their own story" pieces (gn-50-word-grunt / -town / -radio) sit after any battle in S4-S6, optional; gn-50-postcard comes in a later region after the 0-2 Trust ending.

gn-50-word-grunt.note: A beaten Grunt, at a team node. Badge: a folded note.

gn-50-word-town.note: A town NPC. Badge: a folded note.

gn-50-word-radio.note: The team's radio chatter. Badge: a folded note.

gn-50-postcard.note: Afterstory of the 0-2 Trust ending, in a later region.

gn-51-yard.note: Badge: a crate. Better at night. The rescued Pokémon walks beside the player and opens its own scene at each rest stop (run.ts) until it climbs in. Postcards (gn-51-postcard) come one a region afterwards.

gn-51-postcard.note: Afterstory: one postcard a region, until all four are home.

gn-52-manor.level: If it comes to a fight: A+1
gn-52-manor.note: Badge: a mask. At night. Only in a region with an evil-team story. SF125's pop-up black-market auction is a street-corner copy of this. gn-52-later (the lieutenant wonders, a later stage) and gn-52-sale (the manor for sale, a later region) are its afterstories.

gn-52-later.note: Only when both auction traps were avoided.

gn-52-sale.note: Afterstory: "Motivated seller." (a later region of the same run).

gn-53-alarm.level: Grunts A+0; district captains A+1; the commander A+2
gn-53-alarm.note: Badge: a burning tower. Only at the evil team's climax, or the stage before. Eight turns in rooms; the result shapes the next stage's shops and Center (run.ts). The rescued Pokémon waits at the next rest (gn-53-waiting); gn-53-plaque is the afterstory in a later region.

gn-53-plaque.note: Afterstory: the plaque with the names of the allies who held (a later region of the same run).

gn-54-lake.note: Badge: a fish with a ribbon. The town, once towns exist. Three attractions, five regulars and a secret. The board keeps every convention of this run (no memory across runs). gn-54-poster is the afterstory, once in each later region.

gn-54-poster.note: Afterstory: only once one of them has evolved at a convention.

gn-55-bidoof.level: A+2, and then some (a Bidoof's stats, tripled)
gn-55-bidoof.note: Badge: a "!". It is the node's harder wild battle. Once a run (the doc's "once per save"). gn-55-lucan is the afterstory: the boy who laughed crosses the road (two, with the Bidoof in the party).

gn-55-lucan.note: Afterstory: a later stage of the same run.

gn-45-field.level: The lesson A−1 (three Pokémon); the exam A+2 (six)
gn-45-field.note: Badge: a laurel. Once per run, Reputation 3 or more. Instead of the battle. The Champion is the region's own (the cast League Champion once cast). Passing the exam teaches the ace Summit, The Long Game, With You or Seen It; at the real Champion battle that Champion opens with it.

pp-cold-open.level: bullies A-1, Burl A+0 (rematch: the Poliwag +2)

beats.stage: any later evil-team climax or Champion battle

pp-cold-open.note: Stages S1-S6. The cold open places the lessons and the pond visit on later nodes of its stage (core/events.ts pond begin).

sky.opening.level: Pidgey and Spearow match each other at A-1, rising each stage

beats.beat: Stage beats (spar, give, or watch; optional)

sky.opening.note: Best in a run's first region. Once per run.

gn-06-bridge.level: A+0 in the gorge; bridge trainers A-1
gn-06-bridge.note: Kanto shows it through the canon space cs-kanto-cerulean-bridge. The village starter is once per run for each starter (no cross-run memory).

dressing.kantoStage: The road out of Cerulean (the canon space)

gn-07-door.note: Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-cerulean-rain. The opening can not be skipped: "Go on your way" ends it at once.

gn-08-town.level: Lesser A-1, the Leader A+0, the Blastoise A+1

dressing.kantoStage: A town on the road from Cerulean (the canon space)
The cape north of Cerulean (the canon space)

gn-09-door.note: Better at night: the search is always played at night. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-cerulean-bill.

gn-10-dock.note: Needs Bill's Ticket (gn.09) or a spare from the harbour market for 2,000. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-vermilion-ssanne.

gn-11-harbour.note: Badge: a wave. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-vermilion-kaiju (the canon raid den is no longer placed).

gn-11-return.note: Only when the Kaiju was freed.

dressing.kantoStage: The road north of Vermilion (the canon space)

gn-13-check.note: No badge: a surprise. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-vermilion-flight.

dressing.kantoStage: Route 25, on the way to Saffron (the canon space)

gn-15-troop.note: Badge: a red "!". The thieves' camp is a side stop on the next step (op `ahead`) or found first. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-saffron-r25.

gn-15-grove.note: Only when the thieves carried the food back (sorry).

gn-14-door.level: The ghost L10 to L40; Alakazam is the ghost's level +2
gn-14-door.note: The doc says once per save; once per run here (no memory across runs). Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-saffron-labyrinth.

dressing.kantoStage: The cliff town east of Vermilion (the canon space)

gn-12-door.note: Badge: a lantern. Until towns exist it sits on step 9. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-vermilion-maiden.

gn-16-door.level: Every foe scaled exactly to your Mankey or Primeape
gn-16-door.note: Badge: a belt. The stage after gn.15, with its Mankey in the party. Until towns exist it sits on step 15. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-saffron-tournament.

dressing.kantoStage: The coast road near Fuchsia (the canon space)

gn-17-door.note: Badge: a smokestack. Six nodes ending in a three-phase raid. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-fuchsia-factory.

dressing.kantoStage: The coast road near Fuchsia (the canon space)

gn-17-float.note: The same door, must-see, when the player took the stamped float at the Kaiju (gn.11): Mr. Scrimshaw opens the gate and gives the valve order.

gn-18-gate.note: Badge: a paw print. The park is the gn-safari minigame stop the gate opens. Until towns exist it sits on step 12. Kanto shows it through cs-kanto-fuchsia-safari.

gn-18-return.note: The free second visit, after a visit that ended on Quiet 8 or more, the same region.

gn-17-fishing.note: Only after the line was shut down, later the same region.

gn-19-door.note: Badge: a sun. Six nodes. Also opened from Safari Land's far gate (gn-19-far).

gn-19-lone.note: A later region, after the herd was led on without its leader.

gn-20-door.note: Badge: a leaf. Six nodes. Also opened from Safari Land's far gate (gn-20-far).

gn-21-road.note: Badge: a small stone. Once a run (the doc says once per save; no memory across runs).

gn-22-door.note: Badge: a bone. A cold open, then five nodes. Once a run (the doc says once per save; no memory across runs).

gn-23-salesman.level: A+0, four levels higher each time
gn-23-salesman.note: Optional start: the Honest Salesman (SF134.3). In Kanto the canon Magikarp Salesman (cs.kanto.pewter.magikarp) is this scene.

gn-23-a1.level: A+0, four levels higher each time
gn-23-a1.note: Badge: a small fish (notched from the second appearance). Straight after a trainer battle.

gn-23-a2.level: A+0, four levels higher each time

gn-23-a3.level: A+0, four levels higher each time

gn-23-a4.level: A+0, four levels higher each time

gn-23-a5.level: A+0, four levels higher each time

gn-23-falls.level: A+0, four levels higher each time

gn-24-bench.note: The town, until towns exist: step 13. Needs a wild-caught Pokémon owned at least a region. Three visits are follow-ups on later stages of the region.

gn-25-heap.note: Badge: two small shapes, back to back. The node's wild battle becomes the pack fight.

gn-56-door.level: The rare Pokémon at the end of each case: A+0
gn-56-door.note: Badge: a magnifying glass. A Town or Hub stop (until towns exist, step 5). Three cases across three regions, one a region. Six clues a case (three real); the clues read right set the reward tier. SF119 Quennell and NE89 are remembered in the office.

dressing.kanto: Off Vermilion: the Island of Giants

gn-26-door.note: Badge: a very large footprint. Six nodes. Kanto has no older Island of Giants space to replace.

dressing.kanto: Under the Celadon Game Corner: the Rocket Hideout

gn-28-door.note: Badge: a red R (a "?" until the team is known). Four floors: Offices, Labs, Holding, the Vault. The Hideout of the evil-team story (step 7), written out as a stage of its own.

gn-29-town.note: Badge: a small duck. At the town; until towns exist, step 5. Snake in three rounds (core/greenneedle/snake.ts).

gn-30-door.level: A+0; the grove's guards A+1; the Slowking A+1

dressing.kanto: Off the coast: the Island of Pink Pokémon

gn-30-door.note: Badge: a pink dot. Five nodes. A side branch from step 11.

gn-27-gate.level: The arena and the owner A+0
gn-27-gate.note: Badge: a striped tent. At a Town or Hub node; until towns exist, step 10. Returns in later regions with new acts (the trapeze and fire-eater, then the water show and the evolved ace).

gn-62-cell.note: Only in a region with an evil-team story, as an ambush at a team node (the doc's 10%); not in a run where Flight North's theft happened. The doc's other trigger, a loss to a team's lieutenant or boss, opens the cell too (core/greenneedle/prison.ts prisonOnLoss, called from eventBattleLost). Four wings, a clock of six steps, the warden.

gn-62-guard.note: The doc's "inside the team" version: posted here as a guard for one mission. Opens when the player is inside a team (any run flag team-<id>-inside, from the inside route in #1336 / #1339; works whether or not they have merged).

gn-62-stranger.note: Afterstory: one per later stage, for as many strangers' Pokémon as were freed.

gn-31-door.note: Badge: a "?". Six nodes. A side branch from step 12: a gap between two trees that wasn't there on the way in.

dressing.kanto: Under Cerulean Cave: the Crystal Caverns

gn-32-door.note: Badge: a crystal. Six nodes. The Crystal Hollow (SF93) is its front chamber: singing into it opens the Hall of Beams' door.

dressing.kanto: Off the Seafoam coast: the Sunken City

gn-33-door.note: Badge: a drowned tower. Three districts in any order, then the archive. A causeway at low tide, a dive at high. "Once per save" is once per run (no memory across runs).

gn-34-door.note: No badge: the ground opens. The stage after the Sunken City, must-see while the Small Tablet is carried. "Before the battle; the node's battle doesn't happen": it takes the battle's place.

gn-35-door.note: Badge: a lightning bolt. Six nodes. Lightning each node (20%); charged crystals draw Electric-types; three crystals bring the overcharged one to the Shelter, a node early.

gn-36-door.note: Badge: a dune. Eight nodes, three oases, and the traveller's story through it. Water 4, one less a node, refilled at oases; at none, fights start at 90% HP.

gn-37-door.note: Badge: a lit window. A side branch: four floors. SF118's rooms are on these floors. "Once per save" is once per run (no memory across runs).

gn-38-door.note: Badge: a leaf growing through a window. A side branch: five nodes. SF124's Annex scenes are its front rooms (built by the places row). "Once per save" is once per run.

gn-39-door.level: No battles, except the rare-encounter stall (A+0)
gn-39-door.note: Badge: a striped awning. Once per region, in every region, with the same vendors and new stock. Until towns exist it sits on step 10. Vendors remember within the run (no memory across runs).

gn-40-door.note: Badge: an egg. Once per region; the same village, and it remembers (within the run). Until towns exist it sits on step 5. The pair left there comes home in the next region (gn-40-return).

gn-40-return.note: Only while two Pokémon are at the village, in a later region.

gn-41-door.note: Badge: a column. Once per region; each region's museum is different. In Kanto it is separate from Pewter's Museum of Science (cs.kanto.pewter.museum). Until towns exist it sits on step 15.

gn-new-02-platform.note: Badge: a small bowl. Needs a city stage; falls back to step 15. Once a run (the doc says once per save; no memory across runs).

gn-new-02-holiday.note: Afterstory: the clerk on holiday, met at a step 5 town in the next region.

gn-new-14-cabinet.note: Badge: an arcade cabinet. In the back of a shop (a Town stop once towns exist); fallback step 5 of the next stage. Once a run. The three games are choices (mash the buttons panics, time finds shortcuts); the Porygon joins with Debug when all three are cleared. Sold as is: arcade-sold.

gn-new-14-board.note: Afterstory: every later arcade in the same run (first place THX, your initials second; or HELP, still, if sold).

gn-new-18-door.note: Once per region, step 5 (fallback step 15). Six patients, one helper each; each mistake adds one more patient to the queue (up to four), never worsens anything. For the Company patient the player points at a Pokémon, and only the one with the most Bond is right. Reward Standing Welcome: the first Center heal of the region also gives back one Revive (core/greenneedle/welcome.ts).

gn-new-18-parcel.note: Afterstory: a parcel at step 1 of the next region. Mostly bandages; one has a drawing on it.

gn-new-37-nest.level: A-1 if the flock is fought
gn-new-37-nest.note: Once per run. Home step 3, fallback step 8. The afterstory (a Braviary on a low branch) is a callback in a later region.

gn-new-22-court.note: Fallback: step 5 of the next stage. A Meowth drops a coin and leads the player to a rooftop. The challenge is one fight with three calls chosen in the court.

gn-new-22-coin-5.note: Afterstory: coins on windowsills at Steps 5 and 15 for the rest of the region.

gn-new-22-coin-15.note: Afterstory: coins on windowsills at Steps 5 and 15 for the rest of the region.

gn-new-28-bridge.note: Badge: a bridge. Side branch of step 13, at night; fallback step 17, optional. Three fights or one break-out. Once per run. Rope-a-Dope is built as Counter (no such move).

gn-new-28-recruiter.note: Afterstory: only after the cages were opened, a later stage of the same run.

gn-new-28-dojo.note: Afterstory: only after the cages were opened, a later stage of the same run (the doc: a later region).

gn-new-13-door.level: The left Pokémon, scaled to this absolute stage
gn-new-13-door.note: Needs Pokémon left earlier in THIS run (released catches, the Nuzlocke fallen, boxed ones; run memory only, no earlier runs). Once per run. Step 13, fallback step 17. The other Pokémon decide by a seeded shuffle: one walks into the woods, the rest split between a passing trainer and the camp (run flag `left:fates`, read by gn.61). Boxed ones keep their nickname.

gn-new-05-daycare.note: Once per region. Given at Step 5 of the region's Stage 1 at a day-care (fallback Step 15); rocks at the heal node nearest Step 10 each stage; hatches at Stage 8, Step 19.

gn-new-05-rest.note: Once per stage while the egg is carried: the heal node nearest Step 10, or Step 10 itself.

gn-lt-door.note: Finale: only on the run's last stage (the last stage of the last region), step 19, before the final battle. Once per run. +1% to every stat of the party in the last battle per filled place, capped at 10%.

gn-57-crowd.note: Badge: a laurel that looks exactly like the Champion's Training Session's. Once per run, then it recurs.

gn-57-fire.note: At the next rest after playing along.

gn-57-later.note: Once a region after it joins: it imitates the rival, a Champion or the player.

gn-n07-open.note: Badge: an empty shell. Fallback: step 12. Once a run (the doc says once per save; no memory across runs). No battles.

gn-n07-rest.note: The heal (+) node nearest step 10, or step 10 itself, on each of the next three stages. Three acceptances: it joins (more acceptances than silences, after three rests). Three silences: it is gone.

gn-n07-ninjask.note: Only after "Find the Ninjask" at the second rest. Step 12 of the next stage; the third rest waits for it.

gn-new-34.note: Fallback: the warning at Step 15, the slide at Step 19. Once per run; six turns if believed, three if driven off.

gn-new-35-s1.note: S1, Step 10 (must-see; at a + node if one is near), fallback Step 19. Once a run, from A9. One rest per stage, S1–S7; the ending is S8, Step 19.

gn-new-06-d1.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d1.note: Duel 1, the same stage as the critical hit (placed ahead of the player the moment the chosen one is marked). Badge: a leek. Once a run (the doc says per save).

gn-new-06-d1-late.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d1-late.note: Duel 1 again after "Not now": the Duelist is at the next duel's step. It never ambushes.

gn-new-06-d2.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d2.note: Duel 2, the stage after the last duel at the earliest. Optional.

gn-new-06-d2-late.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d2-late.note: Duel 2 again after "Not now": the Duelist is at the next duel's step. It never ambushes.

gn-new-06-d3.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d3.note: Duel 3, the stage after the last duel at the earliest. Optional.

gn-new-06-d3-late.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d3-late.note: Duel 3 again after "Not now": the Duelist is at the next duel's step. It never ambushes.

gn-new-06-d4.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d4.note: Duel 4, the stage after the last duel at the earliest. Optional.

gn-new-06-d4-late.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d4-late.note: Duel 4 again after "Not now": the Duelist is at the next duel's step. It never ambushes.

gn-new-06-d5.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d5.note: Duel 5, the stage after the last duel at the earliest. Optional.

gn-new-06-d5-late.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d5-late.note: Duel 5 again after "Not now": the Duelist is at the next duel's step. It never ambushes.

gn-new-06-d1n.level: Matches the chosen Pokémon exactly; +1 after each of its losses
gn-new-06-d1n.note: Duel 1 when the stage of the critical hit had no step left ahead: the next stage, same steps.

gn-new-09-door.note: Three carriages. The platform is not on the stage map until the player is standing on it. Fallback: step 8, side branch, a node added if no three-node column exists. Night only.

gn-new-09-return.note: Afterstory: on the stage that matches the date on the ticket (5 stages after boarding), the platform is back.

gn-new-33-door.note: Pseudo stage of three legs of flight, at the post office; fallback step 5 of the next stage. Once per run. Badge: a mailbag. The egg hatches a Dratini with Extreme Speed and Tailwind Heart (daycare.ts egg shape).

gn-new-33-roof.note: Afterstory: a retired Dragonite on a post office roof; a parcel for you, a step early (a later stage of the same run).

gn-new-17-beach.note: Badge: a wave. Eight turns (seven if the factory was left running); six tasks, one per Pokémon a turn (core/greenneedle/stranding.ts). Four or more kept up and the tide lifts it; fewer and a second Wailord calls; nobody dies. A Wailmer joins; the next ferry in the region skips one more step (events.ts skipAhead).

gn-new-17-festival.note: Afterstory: a festival in a later region of this run (no cross-run memory), with the Pokémon that calmed it on the banner.

dressing.kanto: The Tyrogue Who Wanted All Three
dressing.elsewhere: The Tyrogue Who Wanted All Three

gn-new-04-door.note: Chain inside one stage: it travels with the player to Step 19. Fallback: Step 15 of the previous stage's town, one stage later.

gn-new-04-road-1.note: One master at the roadside (Sensei Oyelowo), any lane.

gn-new-04-road-2.note: One master at the roadside (Sensei Brannigan), any lane.

gn-new-04-road-3.note: One master at the roadside (Sensei Tachibana), any lane.

gn-new-04-end.note: The ending: a clear lead evolves it; an even split leaves it a Tyrogue with Three Schools.

gn-new-04-sign.note: Afterstory: the three dojos merge; the sign is repainted every time a master wins an argument.

gn-new-25-open.note: Badge: a paint brush. One panel per stage; the subject (walked-past event, close call, catch, kindness, Gym) is picked in core/greenneedle/mural.ts. Fallback step 15. The ending needs six panels on the wall. Afterstory: the Final Reunion shows one wall per region (flag mural-walls).

gn-new-20-ranch.level: A+0 if the dam is broken (a Bibarel and three Bidoof)
gn-new-20-ranch.note: Badge: a water drop. Home step 6, fallback step 11. "Move the colony" spends the next node, "Dig a channel" the next two (a Ground- or Water-type needed). Dug: a Fresh Milk at every rest this region. Broken: sets bibarel-dam-broken (gn.55 reads it).

gn-new-20-road.note: Afterstory: three thin Bidoof on the road a stage later, only if the dam was broken.

gn-new-20-later.note: Afterstory: a Bibarel building by a road in a later region of the same run; broken: it stops and watches.

gn-new-26-door.note: A chain inside one stage: three steps (11, then 12 and 13), the rival walks alongside; fallback steps 16, 17, 18. Any region from A6, after the rival has lost to the player at least once. Once per run. Afterstory: in the rival's next battle the ace is sent out first, and bows (core/greenneedle/missingAce.ts).

gn-new-30-street.note: Chain inside one stage. Fallback step 6, optional. Once per run (the doc says once per run). While they walk with you, in every battle: Plusle +5% Attack, Minun +5% Defence. Both together: Call and Response (core/greenneedle/cheer.ts).

gn-new-10-lake.level: The reflections are the player's own team as it was in the lost (or nearly lost) battle
gn-new-10-lake.note: Badge: a ripple. A side branch at step 8 that needs water; the doc's fallback is step 13, optional (the fallback is gn-new-10-lake-b). Needs a fight lost, or all but one Pokémon lost, this run: run.ts finishBattle keeps the latest such team. Once per run. Win: a Reflection Glass (the doc's "Reflection Shard" is cut with the Shards).

gn-new-10-lake-b.level: The reflections are the player's own team as it was in the lost (or nearly lost) battle
gn-new-10-lake-b.note: The doc's fallback home: step 13, optional, needs water. The same lake as gn-new-10-lake (same rooms); whichever is met first sets `mirror-seen`, so it is once per run.

gn-new-10-late.note: Afterstory: if a reflection watched from the bank, twice more this run at water nodes one is a half second late.

gn-32-pool.level: The battle path: Raikou at A+2

beats.beat: Sighting 1: drinking at a pool (needs high; fallback step 12)
Sighting 2: watching a town from a ridge (fallback step 17)
Sighting 3: standing over a Pichu (fallback step 12)
The fourth meeting: Balls only = fair fight (step 17); waited = the night walk (step 10, near a + node); mixed = the nod

gn-32-pool.note: Badge: a bolt. Once per run (the doc says per save; no memory across runs). Raikou is the battle path (fair, A+2, catchable; it runs if it is losing); the patient path gives the Thundermark (held: Electric moves +20%, Speed +10%). A sheltered Pichu is met later as a Pikachu with Lightning Rod (gn-32-pikachu).

gn-new-23-shop.note: Fallback step 15. Five errands in a row inside the town node (no steps spent). The one it hummed through is a seeded roll at the door. Once per run (the doc's "once per save").

gn-new-23-hub.note: Afterstory, in the same run (no memory across runs): the shop is a hub at a later town. One free held-item repair per visit: a berry that wore out is put back.

gn-new-15-door.level: A-1 wild Pokémon in the rooms
gn-new-15-door.note: Badge: a weather vane. A door at step 12, optional (fallback step 17). A porch, the floor plan with four rooms (scenes) and the tower. Afterstory: a hand-written forecast at step 1 of each later stage (run.ts, core/greenneedle/weather.ts).

gn-n19-door.level: A+0; each extra crate makes one wild encounter A+1
gn-n19-door.note: Door at step 11, optional (the doc prefers a high stage there); fallback step 16, optional (the window runs to 16). Once per run. Four legs.

gn-n19-grown.note: Afterstory: if any crate was left behind, two regions later at a Step 5 town a grown child from that house finds the player.

gn-58-friend.note: Badge: a pawprint. Two or more stages after a Pokémon was let go at the catch screen, in the same kind of place if the stage fits (any place after four stages). One friend an event; others follow if many were let go. Sets gn mark `came-back` on one that rejoins. Within one run.

dressing.kanto: The Night Shift at the Day-Care
dressing.elsewhere: The Night Shift at the Day-Care

gn-new-24.note: Fallback step 19. Five waves. A wave lost: one egg is taken (found hatched at step 7 of a later stage, optional: gn-new-24-found).

gn-new-24-found.note: Only after a wave was lost, a later stage.

gn-new-08-door.note: Badge: a curtain. At night; falls back to step 5 of the next stage. Once per run. Mime Jr. joins with Curtain Call (engine.ts switchIn). The star's bow tie is Bond +2 and a flag; there is no bow tie item. gn-new-08-poster is the afterstory in a later region.

gn-new-08-poster.note: Afterstory: the poster in the next region's step 5 town; the face depends on the ending.

gn-new-16-well.note: Home step 5; the fallback is step 15 (the window's reach). Once per run: well-done. Afterstory for the Final Reunion: it reads well-done (the well is in use, a pebble on the rim).

gn-new-11-door.note: Badge: a lantern. Once per region, at night (fallback: step 10 at night, then the first night join of the next stage). Joining opens the Spirit Market (six lanterns); the last region opens the palanquin for a player who joined every parade.

gn-59-fire.level: The optional battle: A+1, against a team that is one Pokémon short
gn-59-fire.note: Badge: a worn hat. At a + node, once per region. Story and advice by region (6th and on: the empty clip); the request in the last region. Advice pays off in the same region (core/greenneedle/ferris.ts). No cross-run memory: "a later run" is not read.

gn-59-stop.note: The 2nd region's advice: a fog stop this region where "Stop" shows the hidden thing, free.

gn-new-01-open.note: Badge: a small brown paw. Once a run (the doc says once per save; no memory across runs). Best in a run's first or second region.

gn-new-01-end.note: S8 step 19, at a + node if one is near.

gn-new-29-hats.level: Both real teams, as they are
gn-new-29-hats.note: Badge: two hats. Needs Rival Trust 2 or more (the second region or later). Step 15 must-see, fallback step 19. Once per run (declining counts). Rules in core/greenneedle/borrowed.ts: you command the rival's last team, they command yours; the winner gets a Lucky Egg; both learn the other's team and moves; one lingerer each gives a one-battle bonus (+1 Attack to each lead) at the next meeting.

gn-new-21.note: Badge: a stump. At dusk; fallback step 14. Once per region. A rhythm game of four sections (conduct) or the Pokégear recording (find the conductor). gn-new-21-night is the afterstory.

gn-new-21-night.note: Afterstory: the orchestra is heard faintly at Step 1 of every night stage for the rest of the region.

gn-new-12-xatu.note: Step 6 side branch (high ground); fallback Step 11 side branch, then Step 2 optional. Once a run. Look and listen: the whole map (20 columns) and one image drawn from the stop's seeded roll, which will happen (core/greenneedle/cartographer.ts).

gn-new-12-furious.note: Afterstory: only when the run's Legendary Blessing has reached Communion. The image is drawn again.

gn-new-12-natu.note: Afterstory: at the final rest of the run, when the image came true.

gn-new-03-find.note: Badge: a taped Ball. Found once a run, at step 3 of stage 1 or 2 (step 7 is the fallback, the end of the window). From then on its scene opens at every rest (run.ts ballRest) until it comes out (five kindnesses). Hatched, it sets ball-waited and abandoned-mon.

gn-new-03-tinker.note: A town's tinker, once, while the Ball is still in the bag. ₽200 forces it open: it bolts.

gn-new-03-again.note: A later stage after the tinker forced it: the Pokémon, wild, at A+16. It can't be caught.

gn-new-03-after.note: Afterstory: the next region, step 5. A young trainer goes white; the Pokémon stays whichever is picked.

gn-61-field.note: The last stage of the run's last region, step 18; the Long Table (gn.new.38) is step 19. Instead of the battle. Up to three helpers in the final battle (core/greenneedle/reunion.ts).
